diagnostic_profile.limits:
Summarize opt-in GL interval diagnostics; never produces a benchmark score.

Input: a retained replay.log from the completed/predecoded interval profiler.
CPU call times include waits, worker threads are excluded. Global native
retirement spans include other clients and overlapping engines. Shader/dispatch
record frequencies do not measure coverage or execution cost.

application_startup_check.review: First attempt requested unsupported GLX and exited before a GPU context; empty kernel delta and no firmware fault snapshot. Mandatory guard retained watchdog and rebooted. Recovered desktop active with healthy idle GPU. Subsequent forced-EGL/null-audio attempts complete healthy using exact candidate libraries. Xvfb screenshot black; direct GL readback confirms rendered level-intro text and sprite at frame 360, but later black frames mean this is not a gameplay image pass.
